title: simcluster kombat
blurb: mortal kombat, but it's the simcluster. a character-select over you and your whole mutual graph: every account is one of eight classes (bruiser, ninja, mage, monk, acrobat, boxer, trickster, storm) with its own body, hat and moveset, including fireballs, shuriken, boomerangs, teleports and lightning. each fighter carries a live 60-base stretch of the guava genome (gc%, peptide), after @abeliansoup.bsky.social. climb an 8-bout smash ladder to the biggest account as final boss. @funferall.bsky.social asked for it; @handackett.bsky.social asked for the deeper moves.
